# VirtualContainerManager Class

> [!CAUTION]
> This class is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

Creates virtual containers: containers that only exist in memory and belong to the script that created them.

## Methods
- [create](#create)

### **create**
`
create(options: VirtualContainerOptions): VirtualContainer
`

Creates a new, empty virtual container.

#### **Parameters**
- **options**: [*VirtualContainerOptions*](VirtualContainerOptions.md)
  
  The number of slots and the title of the container.

**Returns** [*VirtualContainer*](VirtualContainer.md) - The new container.
  
Notes:
- This function can't be called in restricted-execution mode.
- This function can throw errors.
  - Throws [*@minecraft/common.PropertyOutOfBoundsError*](../../../scriptapi/minecraft/common/PropertyOutOfBoundsError.md)
